BeforeHandDraw.issue: The trigger condition is faithful -- C# checks `CombatManager.Instance.History.CardPlaysFinished.Any(e => e.HappenedLastPlayerTurn(Owner) && e.CardPlay.Card == this)` (Bolas.cs:41) and the sim checks `e.card is card and e.turn == combat.turn - 1` over `CardPlayedEntry` (colorless_attacks.py:523-526) -- and so is the pre-draw turn-start slot. THE PILE SEARCH IS NOT. C# tests only `pile == null || pile.Type != PileType.Hand` and then calls `CardPileCmd.Add(this, PileType.Hand)` (Bolas.cs:43-47), which moves the card to hand from WHEREVER it is -- including the EXHAUST pile. The sim's helper searches only `(player.draw_pile, player.discard_pile)` (colorless_attacks.py:532-535) and silently gives up otherwise, so an exhausted Bolas never comes back. Observable: play Bolas, then exhaust it -- next turn the game returns it to hand and the sim does not. LIVE: card/brand (brand.py:46) and card/burning_pact (burning_pact.py:36) are ported hand-exhausters that pass a NULL filter, so either can select a Bolas that has already returned to hand, and card/second_wind and card/fiend_fire exhaust the hand wholesale. The same helper backs card/thrumming_hatchet (colorless_attacks.py:479-480), which inherits the finding.
